notes.note: packMany は閲覧者なし（upstream 同様）
notes.noteEn: packMany has no viewer (the same as upstream)

notes/children.note: upstream と同じクエリ・フィルタ・パッキング（PG）
notes/children.noteEn: The same query, filters, and packing as upstream (PG)

notes/conversation.note: upstream と同じクエリ・フィルタ・パッキング（PG）
notes/conversation.noteEn: The same query, filters, and packing as upstream (PG)

notes/create.note: NoteCreateService を移植（検証順・エラー id・通知・カウンタ・webhook・ストリーム・AP 配信、公開ノートは LD 署名付きでリレーへも配信）。チャート更新は行わない（charts/* は行から集計）
notes/create.noteEn: Port of NoteCreateService (validation order, error ids, notifications, counters, webhooks, streams, and AP delivery; public notes are also delivered to relays with an LD signature). Charts are not updated (charts/* are aggregated from rows)
notes/create.summary: チャートを更新しない

notes/delete.note: NoteDeleteService を移植（モデレーターも可、他人のノート削除は deleteNote モデレーションログ。Delete は LD 署名付きでリレーへも配信）。renoteCount / notesCount は upstream 同様減らさない
notes/delete.noteEn: Port of NoteDeleteService (moderators are also allowed; deleting someone else's note writes a deleteNote moderation log. Delete is also delivered to relays with an LD signature). renoteCount / notesCount are not decreased, the same as upstream

notes/favorites/create.note: upstream と同じクエリ・フィルタ・パッキング（PG）
notes/favorites/create.noteEn: The same query, filters, and packing as upstream (PG)

notes/favorites/delete.note: upstream と同じクエリ・フィルタ・パッキング（PG）
notes/favorites/delete.noteEn: The same query, filters, and packing as upstream (PG)

notes/featured.note: FeaturedService のランキング（Redis・30% サンプリング）を note_reaction / note 行から同じ窓・スコアで集計して近似。30 分キャッシュは upstream 同様
notes/featured.noteEn: Approximates FeaturedService's ranking (Redis, 30% sampling) by aggregating note_reaction / note rows over the same window and score. The 30-minute cache is the same as upstream
notes/featured.summary: ランキングを PostgreSQL で集計（近似）

notes/global-timeline.note: upstream と同じく DB から取得
notes/global-timeline.noteEn: Fetched from the DB, the same as upstream

notes/hybrid-timeline.note: notes の FanoutTimeline（Redis）を PG 上の同等クエリで再現（enableFanoutTimeline 時は FTT のアルゴリズム、sinceId 時と無効時は getFromDb）。リスト長上限（perUser*TimelineCacheMax）と hibernation は再現しない
notes/hybrid-timeline.noteEn: Reproduces notes' FanoutTimeline (Redis) with an equivalent query on PG (the FTT algorithm when enableFanoutTimeline is on; getFromDb when sinceId is set and when enableFanoutTimeline is off). The list-length limit (perUser*TimelineCacheMax) and hibernation are not reproduced
notes/hybrid-timeline.summary: Redis の代わりに PostgreSQL で同じ結果を返す。件数上限は再現しない
notes/hybrid-timeline.summaryEn: PostgreSQL returns the same results instead of Redis. The length cap is not reproduced

notes/local-timeline.note: notes の FanoutTimeline（Redis）を PG 上の同等クエリで再現（enableFanoutTimeline 時は FTT のアルゴリズム、sinceId 時と無効時は getFromDb）。リスト長上限（perUser*TimelineCacheMax）と hibernation は再現しない
notes/local-timeline.noteEn: Reproduces notes' FanoutTimeline (Redis) with an equivalent query on PG (the FTT algorithm when enableFanoutTimeline is on; getFromDb when sinceId is set and when enableFanoutTimeline is off). The list-length limit (perUser*TimelineCacheMax) and hibernation are not reproduced
notes/local-timeline.summary: Redis の代わりに PostgreSQL で同じ結果を返す。件数上限は再現しない
notes/local-timeline.summaryEn: PostgreSQL returns the same results instead of Redis. The length cap is not reproduced

notes/mentions.note: upstream と同じクエリ・フィルタ・パッキング（PG）
notes/mentions.noteEn: The same query, filters, and packing as upstream (PG)

notes/polls/recommendation.noteEn: The same extraction conditions as upstream

notes/polls/vote.note: PollService 相当（リモート投票は Create(Note) を投票先へ、ローカル投票は Update(Question) をリモートフォロワーと LD 署名付きでリレーへ）
notes/polls/vote.noteEn: Equivalent to PollService (a remote vote sends Create(Note) to the vote target; a local vote sends Update(Question) to remote followers and to relays with an LD signature)

notes/reactions.note: 見えないノートは upstream 同様 INTERNAL_ERROR
notes/reactions.noteEn: A note that is not visible is INTERNAL_ERROR, the same as upstream

notes/reactions/create.note: ReactionService.create を移植（置き換え・通知・ストリーム・Like 配信先＝リモート作者＋フォロワー／specified の可視ユーザー）。Like のカスタム絵文字 tag は付与しない。リアクションバッファリング（enableReactionsBuffering）は非対応で常に即時反映
notes/reactions/create.noteEn: Port of ReactionService.create (replacement, notifications, streams, and Like delivery targets = the remote author + followers / the visible users of specified). A custom-emoji tag is not attached to Like. Reaction buffering (enableReactionsBuffering) is unsupported, and reactions are always applied immediately
notes/reactions/create.summary: リアクションのバッファリングなし

notes/reactions/delete.note: ReactionService.delete を移植（Undo Like をリモート作者とフォロワーへ）。リアクションバッファリングは非対応
notes/reactions/delete.noteEn: Port of ReactionService.delete (Undo Like to the remote author and followers). Reaction buffering is unsupported
notes/reactions/delete.summary: リアクションのバッファリングなし

notes/renotes.note: upstream と同じクエリ・フィルタ・パッキング（PG）
notes/renotes.noteEn: The same query, filters, and packing as upstream (PG)

notes/search.note: SearchService.searchNoteByLike（sqlLike プロバイダ）相当。canSearchNotes ポリシーで UNAVAILABLE。Meilisearch プロバイダは非対応
notes/search.noteEn: Equivalent to SearchService.searchNoteByLike (the sqlLike provider). UNAVAILABLE under the canSearchNotes policy. The Meilisearch provider is unsupported

notes/search-by-tag.note: 安全でないタグは upstream 同様 Error("Injection") → INTERNAL_ERROR
notes/search-by-tag.noteEn: An unsafe tag is Error("Injection") → INTERNAL_ERROR, the same as upstream

notes/show.note: requireSigninToViewContents / makeNotes*Before による非表示・CONTENT_RESTRICTED_BY_* も upstream 同様

notes/show-partial-bulk.noteEn: Returns the same diffs as fetchDiffs
